name: interface/interact
description: Interact with UI elements — click, type, select, scroll. Enables personas to navigate and modify the UI via DOM selectors. Works through shadow DOM boundaries (Lit web components).

params.name: action
params.description: Interaction type: click, type, select, scroll, focus, clear, check

params.name: selector
params.description: CSS selector for target element. Supports shadow DOM piercing via >> (e.g. 'chat-widget >> .send-btn')

params.name: value
params.description: Value for type/select actions. Text to type or option value to select.

params.name: direction
params.description: Scroll direction: up, down, left, right (default: down)

params.name: waitAfterMs
params.description: Wait time after interaction for UI to settle (default: 100)

results.name: elementFound
results.description: True if the selector matched an element

results.name: elementTag
results.description: Tag name of the matched element (e.g. button, input, select)

results.name: elementText
results.description: Text content of the element (truncated to 200 chars)

results.name: previousValue
results.description: Previous value before type/select/clear (for undo context)
